name: Scooter Sharing
description: E-scooter and moped sharing locations and availability

summary.available: {count, plural, =0 {No scooters available} one {1 scooter available} other {# scooters available}}
summary.slots: {count, plural, =0 {No empty slots} one {1 empty slot} other {# empty slots}}

gbfs.purpose: Discover GBFS-compliant shared mobility systems worldwide
gbfs.dataReceived: Station locations/capacity/availability, free-floating vehicle positions, vehicle types, pricing plans

felyx.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire dataset, filtered server-side to bounding box)
felyx.dataReceived: Vehicles with id, coordinates, fuel level, vehicle type

entur-mobility.purpose: Enrich Norwegian e-scooter and moped vehicles with operator branding, pricing plans, rental apps and geofencing zones via the Entur Mobility API
entur-mobility.dataSent: GBFS station and vehicle identifiers (and system identifiers for geofencing) of items already found within the viewport. No user account or raw location data
entur-mobility.dataReceived: Operator branding, pricing plans, vehicle type details, rental apps/URIs, geofencing zones

transitous.purpose: Supplementary e-scooter and moped vehicles from GBFS feeds aggregated by the Transitous (MOTIS) deployment
transitous.dataSent: Bounding-box coordinates (min and max latitude/longitude corners)
transitous.dataReceived: Free-floating vehicle positions, station locations, vehicle types, operator names

nrw-mobidrom-scooter.purpose: NRW.Mobidrom bundled e-scooter feed (Voi + Lime in North Rhine-Westphalia)
nrw-mobidrom-scooter.dataSent: OAuth2 client credentials (no user data; server-only)
nrw-mobidrom-scooter.dataReceived: Per-operator GBFS feeds with vehicle positions, battery levels, vehicle types, pricing plans
